frontier_selector.why: The presence of specific immunohistochemistry markers such as CD20+, Pax5+, BcL-2+, BcL-6+, and Ki67+ (80%) in the splenic biopsy strongly supports the diagnosis of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
